prompt:
Create one 2×2 pixel-art horizontal thinking-gaze atlas for NPC072’s selected GUARDED eye art. Use the single supplied thinking reference grid as the exact face, hair, framing, palette, brow and open/half-lid source. Overall canvas ratio is 64:35; each cell must be the identical complete aligned 64×35 upper-half portrait crop, with no labels, borders, gutters, extra background, full-face panels or independent zoom. Exact row-major cell order: top-left LEFT gaze with OPEN lids; top-right RIGHT gaze with OPEN lids; bottom-left LEFT gaze with HALF-CLOSED lids; bottom-right RIGHT gaze with HALF-CLOSED lids.

Preserve the selected guarded expression exactly: keep its clearly asymmetric skeptical brows fixed in the same positions and shapes in all four cells. Keep the eye apertures and lid positions exactly consistent with the source open phase in the top row and source half phase in the bottom row. Only move each compact olive-gold iris/pupil cluster horizontally by about one native pixel within its existing opening: viewer-left in both LEFT cells, viewer-right in both RIGHT cells. The shift must be gentle and contained; do not change iris size, shape, hue, pupil scale, or vertical position. Preserve muted sclera color and area; do not add broad white bands, bright glints or flash. Keep tiny source-like highlights subdued.

Keep face identity, hair silhouette, skin and eye-shadow palette, crop, pixel proportions and all pixels outside the existing eye regions unchanged. No brow movement between phases, no blink change, no lid widening, no startled eye enlargement, no added eyeliner or thick near-black outlines, no smooth/vector/airbrushed eyes. Crisp native-resolution pixel clusters matching the source.
